context: Two cafe friends discuss tech and home setups
purpose: Teach: フォント/バッテリー/スタンド/アマゾン/ライオン/タンク/カスタマイズ/タマ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店の看板、フォントを変えるだけで雰囲気変わるって。
lines.en: The shop sign — just changing the font can completely shift the whole feeling.
lines.style: Conversational opening, almost thinking aloud. Warm, curious tone. Slight lift at the end like she's sharing an observation she just made. Gentle pace, present in the moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 素敵!カスタマイズしたいわ。
lines.en: That sounds lovely! I'd love to customize something like that.
lines.style: Genuine delight, not performed. Leans in slightly. The enthusiasm of someone imagining possibilities. Soft but clear — she's not loud, but she means it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 業務用タブレット、バッテリーが弱くて。
lines.en: The work tablet's battery life has gotten pretty bad, though.
lines.style: Shifts to practical concern. Matter-of-fact tone, grounded. A small sigh underneath — the weight of a persistent problem. Not complaining, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 近くのスタンドで急速充電できるよ。アマゾンで予備バッテリーも買えるし。
lines.en: You can get a fast charger at the stand nearby. And there are spare batteries on Amazon too, if you want.
lines.style: Helpful, specific, unbossy. Speaking from experience. Steady tone, like offering a solution you've already thought through. Slight pause before 「Amazon」 — not pushing, just offering options.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 動物園のライオン館、毎月通ってる。タマちゃんって名前の白い動物もいるの。
lines.en: I go to the zoo's lion house almost every month. There's this white animal there — they call her Tama.
lines.style: Shifts warmer, more personal. Voice softens. A small genuine smile underneath the words. Conversational pace, like sharing something she cares about. Slight fondness when she says the name.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お弁当のタンクボトル、新調しなきゃ。
lines.en: My lunch bottle's been through a lot — I need to get a new one soon.
lines.style: Tender, practical. Closing the moment gently. Quiet, reflective — speaking more to herself than at the other person. Soft trailing off, inviting agreement or companionship in the mundane.
